notes.title: Small Patch Coming
notes.notes:
We have acknowledged  that there's a bug that stops player in the intro.
We are currently investigating on the why and hows. A small patch will be released in the meantime.
If you have troubles, for the time being, select the "I already know how to cook" option in the new game menu to avoid the bug altogether.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Some of you may have encountered into a bug that didn't load The Cooking Class "scene".
We apologize for the inconvenience and we have fixed the bug already. 
The update should be available any minute.

Thank you.
And sorry.

notes.title: Update coming soon - New Languages, New features
notes.notes:
Hi chefs and players! We carefully listened to all of your positive and negative feedbacks and we're working on a big update that should improve the game quality. 

New language (Italian for now) and new features are coming soon. We've been through all of your comments, we've watched Youtube and Twitch vids and we're working with dedication to give you the best possible experience.
We've found and cooked the bug of the screen resolution that caused problems to many players, and we deeply apologize for that.
We're also adding new features that should make more spicy your cooking class.

Thank you for all the love and support.

Another Dev Company
